_doc: Baseline checks for a release, in execution order. A release ships the whole product, so every check runs. script: path under scripts/. compare_base: when the candidate result is fail or decide, run the check on the last release too, to find problems that the last release already had. required: if the check does not run, the verdict is 'incomplete'. gate: the check must pass on the candidate, even if the last release had the same failure. profile: fast (default) or full.

checks.title: Version files agree, and the version bump matches the commits
The changelog describes what ships
CI ran and passed on the candidate, or on the main commit below it
go mod tidy makes no change to go.mod or go.sum
go build and go vet
go test ./... (isolated environment)
go generate makes no change, and the generated code builds
govulncheck: no new reachable vulnerabilities since the last release
golangci-lint (pre-commit configuration)
UI: npm ci resolves
UI lint (eslint)
UI format (prettier --check)
UI tests (vitest)
UI builds, and the committed dist/ is current
UI: npm audit (runtime dependencies), no new advisories
actionlint
Third-party actions use a commit SHA (SEC-7924)
Binary smoke test: --version, help for all commands, dev-server serves the UI and API
Commands, flags, and defaults compared with the last release
The npm package contains only the files it needs
All release targets cross-compile in goreleaser-cross (CGO)
The release image builds and runs
